registration_modes.mode_a: Regular registration. Fulfill class attendance requirement and appear in all components of evaluation.
registration_modes.mode_b: Appear in all components of evaluation (not applicable for laboratory courses). Requires fulfilling attendance in an earlier semester.
registration_modes.mode_c: Appear in end semester exam only. Previous sessional marks will be considered. Requires fulfilling attendance in an earlier semester.

attendance_rules.repeating_students: If a student already fulfilled attendance in a previous attempt, they will not be detained due to attendance again.

repetition_and_backlog_rules.failed_theory_but_completed_attendance: Can register again in Mode 'b' or Mode 'c'.
repetition_and_backlog_rules.failed_lab_but_completed_attendance: Can register again in Mode 'a' or Mode 'c'.
repetition_and_backlog_rules.improving_passed_course: Allowed only ONCE if the course was passed in a single attempt. Must register in Mode 'b' or 'c'. For CGPA, the better grade is counted.

promotion_criteria.to_semester_3_or_4: Minimum 16 earned credits by end of Semester II.
promotion_criteria.to_semester_5_or_6: Minimum 60 earned credits (including at least 36 credits from first two semesters) by end of Semester IV.
promotion_criteria.to_semester_7_or_8: Minimum 108 earned credits (including at least 80 credits from first four semesters) by end of Semester VI.
promotion_criteria.penalty: If 'Not Promoted' more than three times, admission is cancelled.

special_registrations.graduating_course: Max 1 course of <= 4 credits allowed if it enables graduation. Evaluated on End-Semester Exam only.
special_registrations.minor_degree: Requires CGPA >= 7.5 at the end of second semester with no backlogs.
